q: What was net revenue and contribution margin by business line last month vs budget?

r.narrative: September 2026 net revenue was €11.98M against a €12.24M budget (−€0.26M, −2.1%, unfavourable) and contribution margin €3.57M against €3.69M (−€0.12M, −3.3%). Road Groupage explains about two-thirds of the gap as margin per shipment fell in Marseille-Vitrolles, Rouen and Mulhouse. Customs Brokerage is on budget at a 45% contribution margin.
r.sql:
-- verified query: bl_vs_budget_last_month (SDP_HEPPNER.PUBLIC.SV_HEPPNER_FINANCE)
SELECT business_line,
  SUM(CASE WHEN scenario = 'Actual' THEN net_revenue END) / 1e6 AS net_revenue_actual_m,
  SUM(CASE WHEN scenario = 'Budget' THEN net_revenue END) / 1e6 AS net_revenue_budget_m,
  SUM(CASE WHEN scenario = 'Actual' THEN contribution_margin END) / 1e6 AS cm_actual_m,
  SUM(CASE WHEN scenario = 'Budget' THEN contribution_margin END) / 1e6 AS cm_budget_m
FROM SDP_HEPPNER.PUBLIC.FACT_AGENCY_MONTHLY
WHERE period = '2026-09' AND scenario IN ('Actual', 'Budget')
GROUP BY business_line ORDER BY 2 DESC;

q: Which agencies have the biggest margin-per-shipment decline YTD and why?

r.narrative: Three agencies explain most of the decline in contribution margin per shipment YTD (Jan–Sep 2026 vs 2025): Mulhouse −23.5%, Marseille-Vitrolles −22.4% and Rouen −17.8%. Mulhouse has 38% cross-border volume with a quarterly surcharge reset (the Q1 diesel spike was recovered three months late) and 22% temporary dock labour; Marseille-Vitrolles lost a retail key account (14% of volume) in March while hub costs stayed; Rouen subcontracts pickup & delivery at €1.78/km versus €1.32 own fleet after two driver vacancies. Together they are €0.6M behind budget YTD.
r.sql:
-- verified query: agency_margin_per_shipment_decline_ytd (SDP_HEPPNER.PUBLIC.SV_HEPPNER_FINANCE)
SELECT agency_name, agency_region, margin_per_shipment_ytd_2025_eur, margin_per_shipment_ytd_2026_eur,
       change_pct, contribution_margin_change_eur_m, controller_commentary
FROM SDP_HEPPNER.PUBLIC.RPT_AGENCY_MARGIN_DECLINE_YTD
ORDER BY rank_decline;

q: What is the impact on FY27 EBITDA if diesel rises 15% and surcharge lags 2 months?

r.narrative: A 15% diesel rise with the fuel surcharge lagging two months costs €1.67M of FY2027 EBITDA: €18.80M → €17.13M, margin 6.2% → 5.6%. Fuel cost (own fleet plus fuel in carrier rates) rises €4.01M; the surcharge recovers only €2.34M because clauses pass on about 70% of an increase and nothing in the first two months. With a one-month lag the hit is €1.44M; with no lag €1.20M.
r.sql:
-- verified query: fy27_diesel_plus15_lag2 (SDP_HEPPNER.PUBLIC.SV_HEPPNER_FINANCE)
SELECT scenario_name, metric, base_value / 1e6 AS base_m, scenario_value / 1e6 AS scenario_m, impact / 1e6 AS impact_m
FROM SDP_HEPPNER.PUBLIC.FACT_SCENARIO_RESULTS
WHERE scenario_name LIKE 'Diesel +15%%' AND metric IN ('EBITDA', 'EBITDA_MARGIN_PCT');

q: How much did freight-flow optimisation save in subcontracting this quarter?

r.narrative: Freight-flow optimisation saved €0.17M of subcontracted transport in Q4 to date (1–26 October, 101.7k km), after €0.58M in Q3 2026 (356k km, about 2.5% of subcontracted road km). Freight agents accept 70.5% of the groupings the model proposes every 10 minutes, up from 67.9% in Q3. These savings now flow into the subcontracting plan as a cost driver.
r.sql:
-- verified query: freight_flow_savings_this_quarter (SDP_HEPPNER.PUBLIC.SV_HEPPNER_FINANCE)
SELECT CASE WHEN savings_date >= '2026-10-01' THEN 'Q4 2026 to date' ELSE 'Q3 2026' END AS period,
       SUM(eur_saved) / 1e6 AS eur_saved_m, SUM(km_saved) AS km_saved,
       SUM(groupings_accepted) / SUM(groupings_proposed) * 100 AS acceptance_pct
FROM SDP_HEPPNER.PUBLIC.FACT_FREIGHT_OPT_SAVINGS
WHERE savings_date BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-10-26' GROUP BY 1;

q: Generate a CFO briefing for the monthly close

r.narrative: September 2026 close: slightly behind budget on every line, and margin is falling faster than revenue. YTD revenue is €210.38M (−1.9%) and YTD EBITDA €12.33M (−€0.95M). The Q3 Forecast lands FY2026 at €286.8M revenue and €17.07M EBITDA against a €292.8M / €18.13M budget. Watch items: the CNR diesel index peaked at €1.82/L in March (+19.7% vs budget) and is €1.60 in September; Mulhouse, Marseille-Vitrolles and Rouen lost 18–24% of margin per shipment; freight-flow optimisation saved €0.58M in Q3 and €0.17M so far in Q4. Next actions: agency turnaround plans, a monthly CNR surcharge reset at the 2027 renewals, and a 75% grouping acceptance target.
r.sql:
-- verified query: cfo_monthly_close_briefing (SDP_HEPPNER.PUBLIC.SV_HEPPNER_FINANCE)
SELECT section, item, actual_or_forecast, budget_or_comparison, variance
FROM SDP_HEPPNER.PUBLIC.RPT_CFO_CLOSE_BRIEFING
ORDER BY sort_order;

q: Where does the FY2026 Q3 Forecast land versus budget by business line?

r.narrative: The Q3 Forecast lands FY2026 revenue at €286.8M, €6.0M (−2.1%) below the €292.8M budget, and EBITDA at €17.07M against €18.13M. Road Groupage is €4.1M of the revenue gap and Full Truckload €1.0M; Customs Brokerage is on budget with the highest margin in the group.
r.sql:
SELECT business_line,
  SUM(CASE WHEN scenario = 'Forecast' THEN revenue END) / 1e6 AS fcst_m,
  SUM(CASE WHEN scenario = 'Budget' THEN revenue END) / 1e6 AS budget_m
FROM SDP_HEPPNER.PUBLIC.FACT_AGENCY_MONTHLY
WHERE fiscal_year = 2026 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;
